claim_ceiling: TF-IDF 174k complete and production-ready (cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5: LangDom=0.4773, JuristPref=0.7345). Linear combinations (equal concat of center_projected_64 + cited_decisions_tfidf) pass both adversarial gates at 19-year scale (122k decisions) with JP=0.545, LangDom=0.767, partially breaking the two-mode tradeoff. However, JuristPref ceiling remains at ~0.54 for stable combinations, cross-lingual transfer remains weak (zero_shot_nmi ~0.2), and citation independence is sacrificed (CiteIndep ~0.31 vs 0.505 for metric-learning baseline). Full 174k dense embeddings blocked by source data gap (51,948 decisions missing, parquet missing, bge_<->bger_ ID mapping missing). Two-mode tradeoff reproduced at all scales: no single representation dominates all metrics. Product must expose multiple map modes.
evidence_summary: Verified across 9 primary evidence files: (1) TF-IDF 174k formal suite (all 8 PASS both gates: best cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 LangDom=0.4773, JP=0.7345); (2) 19-year dense eval (all 4 center-projected/raw modes FAIL: LangDom 0.86-0.98, JP 0.047-0.369); (3) 19-year linear combinations (linear_citation_concat PASS both: LangDom=0.767, JP=0.545; linear_hybrid05_concat PASS both: LangDom=0.778, JP=0.540); (4) 15-year linear hybrid baseline (JP=0.473 FAIL); (5) Section cross-lingual (all modes FAIL: sachverhalt invariance_gap=0.187, erwaegungen invariance_gap=0.452); (6) v8 holdout validation (4 zero-shot TF-IDF hybrids PASS on true holdout, leakage minimal: LangDom delta ~0.06-0.10, JP delta ~0.03); (7) Dense checkpoint progress (122,015/173,963 decisions, 19/26 years); (8) v29 final report (synthesis consistent with evidence); (9) Lane state legal-distance.json (BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES, continue_recommended=false). No leakage, gaming, post-hoc metrics, or unsupported claims detected. Negative results honestly reported.
